objectives: This course is taught in English. Introduction to Business is a fundamental course in business and organizational management education. This course is offered by many departments in the management school. Although its contents may be varied due to the different professional focuses of the departments, the main teaching subjects and learning objectives (see below) of this course are maintained to be consistent among its instances. The major teaching subjects include global economic systems, organization structures, basic management functions (human resources, marketing, etc.), leadership ＆ teamwork, and business ethics.
content:
Part 1: INTRODUCTION
-	Course introduction
Part 2: THE CONTEMPORARY BUSINESS WORLD
-	Overview of contemporary business environment
-	Business ethics ＆ social responsibility
-	Entrepreneurship ＆ business ownership
-	The global context of business
Part 3: THE BUSINESS OF MANAGING
-	Business management
-	Organizing the business
-	Operations management ＆ quality
Part 4: PEOPLE IN ORGANIZATIONS
-	Employee behavior ＆ motivation
-	Term project proposal presentation: Selling your idea
-	Leadership and decision making
-	Human resource management ＆ labor relations
Part 5: PRINCIPLES OF MARKETING
-	Marketing processes and consumer behavior
-	Pricing, distributing and promoting products
-	Term project final presentation: Showing your accomplishment
books: 鄭仁偉（2017）。企業概論。華泰文化。
